statement: ObjectSnapshot's 5 fields are ordered by the ascending byte order of their encoded keys (shorter keys first) (sem: SEM-gx-canon-136)
origin: gx self-authored; the hex was hand-assembled from RFC 8949 §3's major-type/additional-info table and 42 §2.1's six rules (not copied from encoder output) (sem: SEM-gx-canon-137)
note: key order = id(2) digest(6) locator(7) substrate(9) representation(14). Not declaration order. (sem: SEM-gx-canon-138)
